objective: Create a descriptor-only document/media contract for inline, thumbnail, gallery, viewer, link and download modes, PDF initial page/preview metadata and permission-gated open/download/share/print actions routed through LinkWiz.

coordination.media_wiz: Existing media-wiz.js remains unchanged; this contract does not compose or inject its HTML strings.
coordination.link_wiz: Existing LinkWiz is consumed as the canonical link descriptor/security layer and remains unchanged.
coordination.file_format_registry: Existing FileFormatRegistry is consumed for format/icon metadata and remains unchanged.
coordination.parallel_agents: No MEDIA-DOCUMENT lock found before reservation.

notes: No MediaWiz/FileFormatRegistry/LinkWiz/demo modifications. Future renderer integration is a separate lot.
